title: Full faithfulness preserves tensor-unit global sections
statement: Let D and E be preadditive monoidal categories with additive tensor product. Let F:D -> E be a fully faithful strong monoidal additive functor and R a monoid object of D. The induced ring homomorphism Gamma.mapFunctor F from Gamma R to Gamma(FR), where Gamma is the convolution ring of tensor-unit morphisms [lem-zl-section-ring-global-sections], is bijective.

proof.text: For F fully faithful use its homEquiv, then precompose by the inverse tensor-unit comparison. This equivalence is Γ.mapFunctor after cancelling the final identity. Therefore Γ.mapFunctor is bijective.
